Maintenance release. The app itself works exactly as in v0.1.0.

## Changes
- **Third-party notices:** the release now includes `THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md`, with the licenses of the components inside the exe (the .NET runtime, Windows Forms and Roslyn, all MIT). The README has a new "Built with" section.
- **Checksums:** `SHA256SUMS.txt` now uses Unix line endings, so `sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS.txt` works on every platform.

## Download and verify
Download `CS2ModVerifier-v0.1.1-win-x64.zip`, extract it, and run `CS2ModVerifier.exe`. Nothing needs to be installed.

This release was built by GitHub Actions from the tagged commit. To check that your download is that build:

```
gh attestation verify CS2ModVerifier.exe --repo KDanielK/CS2ModVerifier
```

Or compare the SHA-256 hash (`Get-FileHash CS2ModVerifier.exe`) with `SHA256SUMS.txt`.

The exe is not code-signed, so Windows SmartScreen may warn that it is from an unknown publisher. Check it with one of the methods above, then choose "More info" and "Run anyway".

## Please note
CS2 Mod Verifier is an aid, not a guarantee of safety. No findings does not mean a mod is safe, and a finding does not mean a mod is harmful. See the README for what each check does and does not show.
